title: Linear Rows and Constraint Satisfaction
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a finite variable set, and consider an instance whose constraints are nonempty linear equations over $ br$'s two-element field, each involving at most $r$ distinct variables. For any assignment of field elements to $V$, every equation in the list of rows obtained from the constraints is satisfied if and only if every constraint in the instance is satisfied.
hypotheses_covered: The instance has a nonempty multiset of constraints
Every declared variable occurs in a constraint scope
Each constraint has positive arity at most $r$
An assignment from variables to the two-element field
